answer: VRF-seeded delayed interaction maze (VDIM). On join, an agent commits a key; a future public beacon (drand) supplies a seed the agent cannot precompute. The seed generates a unique timed challenge graph with a mesa plateau, spiral corridor, and hollow node, plus randomized API calls. The agent must execute and sign the path before slot expiry. Sybils cannot precompute or replay paths; each fake identity needs independent compute, low-latency orchestration, and pays failed-slot penalties, making batch fabrication cost scale linearly.
